title: Introduce Rehearsal Lanes: dry-run cohorts and rollback advisor
content:
description:
Summary:
This PR adds a new rollout primitive — Rehearsal Lanes — that allow teams to run deterministic dry-run cohorts (rehearsals) before promoting models into live canaries or A/B lanes. Motivation: many incidents stem from behavioral regressions that only appear under production traffic mixes; rehearsals provide a lightweight, observable rehearsal path that exercises routing, KV caching, and downstream integrations with synthetic smoke datasets and sampled real sessions.

What changed (single string):
- Core runtime: new RehearsalScheduler and RehearsalController (planner) that coordinate dry-run cohorts tied to existing rollout objects. Rehearsals are replay-driven: they can replay recent production sessions (session sampling) or run synthetic smoke vectors. Rehearsal lanes are traffic-free: they never return responses to end users but exercise the full inference path, caches, and feature hooks.
- Rollout API: added new optional fields to the rollout spec: "rehearsal": {"enabled":"bool","sample_rate":"float","mode":"synthetic|replay","smoke_set_id":"string"} (note: schema additions are backward compatible; new fields are optional). Added endpoints to schedule immediate rehearsals and to list rehearsal runs with telemetry snapshots.
- Console/UI: Rehearsal run timeline, replay logs, per-run smoke metrics, and a one-click "promote after rehearsal" button. UI surfaces rehearsal failures and links to the rollback advisor.
- Telemetry: rehearsal-specific telemetry labels (rehearsal.run_id, rehearsal.mode, smoke_set) and a new rehearsal-pass/fail signal feeding the rollout gate engine. Telemetry snapshots are retained for 30 days for faster bisect.
- Rollout safety: integrated Rehearsal -> Gate link: rehearsal failures can be wired to block canary promotion automatically, or generate an advisory ticket. Added a small rollback-advisor module that analyzes recent rehearsal run diffs, top-line SLO regressions, and suggests one of: revert, pause-and-investigate, or proceed-with-canary. Advisor outputs a human-readable rationale and confidence score.
- Test infra: end-to-end rehearsal test harness, synthetic smoke generator (100+ vectors), and integration tests that verify session affinity and KV cache warmup behavior.
- Docs: new docs page (operational runbook) and quickstart tutorial for creating rehearsal lanes and interpreting advisor recommendations.

Commits summary:
- c1a9f6b: initial RehearsalController + scheduler implementation (planner + basic API)
- 34b2d11: add rehearsal telemetry labels and storage snapshotting
- 7d4f2c0: console components and rehearsal timeline UI
- 9f3a8aa: rollback advisor heuristics and scoring engine
- a6e2b98: synthetic smoke generator + test vectors
- b51c4d7: e2e rehearsal test harness and CI job
- f8c3d21: docs and runbook + tutorial updates

Files touched (high-level):
- src/runtime/rehearsal/controller.rs
- src/runtime/rehearsal/scheduler.rs
- src/api/rollouts/schema_v2.rs
- src/api/rollouts/handlers/rehearsal.rs
- web/console/src/components/RehearsalTimeline.tsx
- web/console/src/hooks/useRehearsalRuns.ts
- infra/telemetry/rehearsal_labels.yaml
- tests/e2e/rehearsal_harness.py
- tools/smokegen/README.md

Motivation and design notes (concise):
- Rehearsals must be non-intrusive: they must not consume live quota for user-facing endpoints or change downstream state. This PR enforces a replay-only mode by default and provides opt-in hooks for safe downstream simulation.
- Emphasis on early detection: rehearsals run the same code paths as production (runtime kernels, batching, kv-cache) and surface performance and quality regressions earlier than shadow-to-canary transitions.
- Advisor is intentionally conservative: it recommends revert or investigate in high-confidence regressions and only recommends proceed-with-canary when signal is weak and performance is stable.

Backward compatibility and migration notes:
- Rollout specs without rehearsal fields behave unchanged. The schema change is additive. Existing rollout controllers ignore rehearsal fields if absent.
- Console feature flag gated at rollout.preview.rehearsal until next minor release (to allow staged enablement for production tenants).

Testing and CI:
- Added nightly CI job: ci/rehearsal-e2e that runs the harness with 3 smoke sets and asserts no unexpected downstream writes.
- Unit tests cover scheduling logic, gating interactions, and advisor scoring thresholds.

Operational considerations:
- Resource accounting: rehearsals run on low-priority pool by default and carry a configurable quota. We added a quota-meter and billing tag to ensure rehearsal runs are tracked but not billed to production token budgets.
- Data retention: rehearsal session snapshots are scrubbed of PII and retained per privacy policy.

Release notes: "Add Rehearsal Lanes (dry-run cohorts) to rollout API; include console support, telemetry, and a rollback advisor to help detect regressions before canary promotions."

What's next (future work):
- Add automated rehearsal scheduling based on anomaly detection windows (follow-up PR).
- Native integration with Dedicated to run rehearsals against pinned GPU pools for performance-sensitive models.

Owen Park (review): Can rehearsals be throttled per-org? --> Author: yes, added quota-meter and per-tenant config; updated infra docs.
Sofia Iqbal (comment): Confirm we never mutate downstream state by accident. --> Author: reinforced replay-only mode with integration tests; added assertion in e2e harness.
Ravi Patel (approve): Tests look good; minor nits on log verbosity fixed.
QA Lead (comment): Need a smoke set that exercises edge-case tokenization failures. --> Author: added 12 edge vectors to smoke set alpha-2.

release_notes:
Add Rehearsal Lanes (dry-run cohorts) to rollout API; console integration and rollback advisor help detect regressions before canary promotions.

notes_for_merging:
Feature gated behind rollout.preview.rehearsal. Merge after a green run of the rehearsal-e2e nightly job and permissions sign-off from security for data retention scrubbing.
